pins.title: Set your pole height right
pins.sub: Elbows at about 90 degrees on flat ground. A bit shorter going up, a bit longer coming down.

pins.title: What to pack for a day hike
items: Map, phone and a power bank
Rain shell and a warm layer

pins.title: Start cold on the climb
pins.sub: Begin a little chilly so you don't sweat. Put the fleece on at breaks and at the top.

pins.title: Fall color without the crowds
pins.sub: Buy your parking tag before you arrive and start at sunrise on a weekday.

pins.title: Hiking in hunting season
pins.sub: Check local season dates, wear blaze orange on your body and pack, and stay on the trail.
